info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bank Drafts Management API
info.description: The Bank Drafts Management API allows consumers to update existing bank drafts, ensuring that transaction details remain accurate and up-to-date. This endpoint is critical for financial institutions and their customers who need to modify information on bank drafts, whether for corrections, adjustments, or compliance purposes. Users of this API typically include bank officers, consumer service representatives, and application developers within the financial services sector. By facilitating seamless updates, this API enhances the reliability of bank draft transactions.

patch.description: This operation allows clients to update the details of a specific bank draft identified by its unique identifier. Ensure that the modifications comply with the existing business rules and requirements.

requestBody.description: Updates specific details of the bank draft identified by RES-100045. This operation allows clients to modify attributes such as amount, status, and other relevant information through a JSON payload.
